prompt:
Use case: logo-brand. Asset: one square app icon artwork, full-bleed opaque 1:1 canvas, the ground colour runs edge to edge; no rounded corners, no border, no frame, no text, no letters except where stated.
Subject: a classic portable typewriter seen from the front, reduced to one emblem: a low wide body in deep jade-green enamel (#2E8C6A lit, #1F6B50 in shade), a charcoal platen roller across its top, and a fresh white sheet of paper (#FFFFFF with cool-grey shading) rising straight up out of the roller; the keyboard reduced to a single neat row of five round ivory keys.
Ground: pure white #FFFFFF with a very soft cool-grey tonal shift toward the lower right.
Composition: a centred mark whose longest side is about 70 percent of the canvas, with even breathing room; the sheet of paper is the tallest part.
Charming detail: near the top of the sheet a single short typed line of four tiny dark marks ends in a small solid cursor block, as if the writer just paused.
Rendering: a modern app-icon mark, the thing abstracted into one emblem with one continuous calm silhouette, rendered as flat shapes with a soft tonal gradient, crisp edges, no puffy inflated volume; one soft light from the upper left; not a photograph, not a 3D product render, not a toy in a scene. The eye should read the whole picture in one glance: only the parts named here exist, nothing else is added.
Remove: brand plates, screws, spools, ribbon, levers, a second row of keys, a desk, readable words; only jade green, white, ivory, charcoal and soft grey. One clear focal subject that reads instantly at 48 pixels.
